incident-bot: Paging @mira-g :rotating_light: - high token-meter delta detected for customer Halcyon Health (halcyon-prod, dedicated-vpc pool)
ops-bot: alert rule: billing.meter.delta > 2.0 for 6h window. current delta=3.4x
mira-g: I'm on it, looking at metering-collector logs and dedicated pool usage. Pulling last 24h tokens
jordan-p: pinging billing team @devin-billing in case this is accounting side
devin-billing: saw a spike in token_count_events coming from the 'halcyon-prod' pool at 02:12 UTC. Possibly duplicate writes
mira-g: running query: ```SELECT count(*) as events, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM token_events WHERE pool='halcyon-prod' AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY source``` — will post results
mira-g: query results: source=ingest-worker-42 events=1,245,612 tokens=1,198,112,233 ; source=inference-runtime-7 events=1,240,998 tokens=1,197,998,456
mira-g: those look nearly identical — suspicious replication or double-publish between runtime and ingest
sam-rt: could be the vpc connector retrying on a transient error and republishing. Any retry dedupe id? /cc @devin-billing
devin-billing: we log dedupe_id; checking. If dedupe missing, counts duplicate. I see a spike in `publish_failures` followed by `publish_success` from the connector at 02:11-02:13 UTC
tess-cs: customer impact? Halcyon is enterprise, billing monthly commit. Need to inform CS and legal if this affects invoice
mira-g: mitigation: 1) pause billing ingestion pipeline for halcyon-prod (dry-run), 2) enable dedupe filter on aggregator, 3) route live requests to fallback pool to avoid further double counts
mira-g: pausing ingestion: `./ctl billing pause --tenant halcyon-prod` -> ack: paused by mira-g @ 1945002230
ops-bot: action taken: billing-ingest-halcyon paused (runbook: billing/ingest-pause) :white_check_mark:
devin-billing: enabling dedupe filter now. config patch:
```
filters:
  - name: dedupe_by_id
    window: 30s
```
devin-billing: dedupe enabled on aggregator at 1945002805
jordan-p: routing live traffic: `routing set pool halcyon-prod fallback=halcyon-fallback-01` — executing
mira-g: routing change applied, traffic draining from halcyon-prod to fallback; should stop duplicate writes
sam-rt: monitoring inbound events vs tokens after change
